notice: This packet contains independent verification evidence and reviewed definition drafts for the 12 VS6 pilot candidates. It deliberately omits approval-only fields (decision, reviewer, reviewedOn, approvalReference). Only an authorized approver may turn an eligible candidate into an approved SettlementReview.

existingAtlas.duplicateScanResult: no identity, location or key collisions; no alias match within 50 km; no coordinate within 1 km

method.identitySource: Pleiades published record read via the public JSON API /places/<id>/json (the HTML page is behind the Anubis anti-bot layer); independently corroborated by ToposText listing the same Pleiades id.
method.locationSource: ToposText coordinates cross-checked against the Pleiades representative point.
method.coordinatePolicy: Reviewed coordinates use the Pleiades representative point, matching the existing atlas convention.

limitations: Pleiades HTML pages are protected by Anubis; records were read via the public JSON API. A one-time human confirmation of each HTML URL is recommended before final approval.
The reviewed earliest-evidence date is a conservative floor; it is not required to be precise and does not by itself establish campaign presence.
Political control in 278 BCE is uncertain for several candidates (notably Akragas and Catana) and is recorded as medium confidence; it does not affect existence or location.

caveats: Legal status (socius vs subject) in 278 BCE is not fully resolved.
Ancient shoreline and the extent of the Graviscae port are reconstructed.
